function reviewStorageKey(){return 'hisa_reviews_product_'+activeProductId}
function getProductReviews(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(reviewStorageKey())||'[]')}catch(e){return []}}
function renderProductReviews(){
const items=getProductReviews(), list=document.getElementById('reviewList'), summary=document.getElementById('reviewSummary');
list.replaceChildren();
if(!items.length){summary.textContent='No reviews yet. Be the first to review this product.';return}
const avg=(items.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.rating,0)/items.length).toFixed(1);
summary.textContent=avg+' / 5 stars · '+items.length+' customer review'+(items.length===1?'':'s');
items.slice().reverse().forEach(r=>{
const div=document.createElement('div');div.className='review-item';
const name=document.createElement('strong');name.textContent=r.name;
const stars=document.createElement('div');stars.className='review-stars';stars.textContent='★'.repeat(r.rating)+'☆'.repeat(5-r.rating);
const comment=document.createElement('p');comment.textContent=r.text;
div.append(name,stars,comment);list.append(div)
})
}
function submitProductReview(e){
e.preventDefault();
const name=document.getElementById('reviewName').value.trim(),text=document.getElementById('reviewText').value.trim(),rating=Number(document.getElementById('reviewRating').value);
if(!name||text.length<10||rating<1||rating>5){alert('Please enter your name, rating and a review of at least 10 characters.');return}
const items=getProductReviews();items.push({name:name.slice(0,70),text:text.slice(0,1200),rating});
try{localStorage.setItem(reviewStorageKey(),JSON.stringify(items))}catch(err){alert('Your browser could not save the review.');return}
e.target.reset();renderProductReviews();alert('Review saved in this browser preview.');}

'cancellation':`<h1>Cancellation &amp; Refund Policy</h1><p class="policy-notice"><strong>Policy pending business confirmation:</strong> Specific cancellation windows, return eligibility, refund timelines and return-shipping responsibilities have not yet been finalized. Please confirm these before publishing the site.</p><h2>Before order confirmation</h2><p>A cart sent through WhatsApp is an order request. You may change or withdraw the request before Hisa Organic confirms the final order.</p><h2>After confirmation</h2><p>For any cancellation, damaged goods, incorrect products, return or refund request, contact us on WhatsApp at <a href="https://wa.me/918446441401">+91 84464 41401</a>. We will review the circumstances and communicate the applicable resolution and terms. This does not limit rights available under applicable law.</p>`,
'privacy':`<h1>Privacy Policy</h1><p>When you prepare an order, the website may ask for your name, mobile number, delivery address, PIN code and order details. These details are used to prepare your WhatsApp order message and to communicate about quotations, delivery and customer support.</p><h2>WhatsApp orders</h2><p>When you click “Place Order on WhatsApp”, your WhatsApp application or website opens with the order message. The message is not sent until you choose to send it. WhatsApp processes communications under its own privacy terms.</p><h2>Reviews and local storage</h2><p>In this preview version, submitted reviews are stored in the current browser only, using local storage; they are not shared publicly or transmitted to Hisa Organic. Cart data may also be kept in the page while you browse.</p><h2>Contact</h2><p>For privacy questions or requests relating to information you have sent to Hisa Organic, contact <a href="https://wa.me/918446441401">+91 84464 41401</a>.</p><p class="policy-notice">Before going live, this policy must be updated to reflect the actual hosting, analytics, review database, retention and data-handling practices.</p>`,
'terms':`<h1>Terms &amp; Conditions</h1><h2>Product information</h2><p>Product descriptions and images are provided for general information. Some photographs are illustrative. Please verify ingredients, technical specifications, intended use, availability and suitability before purchasing.</p><h2>Pricing and orders</h2><p>Displayed soap-base prices are indicative for the current catalogue and may be updated. Shipping, taxes where applicable, minimum order quantities and final payment terms will be confirmed in the WhatsApp quotation. Adding products to a cart does not constitute an accepted sale.</p><h2>Safe product use</h2><p>Customers are responsible for checking whether products are suitable for their formulations and for complying with relevant safety, labelling and regulatory requirements for finished goods.</p><h2>Contact</h2><p>For questions about these terms, message <a href="https://wa.me/918446441401">+91 84464 41401</a>.</p>`,
'faq':`<h1>Frequently Asked Questions</h1><h2>How do I place an order?</h2><p>Open Soap Bases, select products, choose quantities, add them to the cart and enter your delivery details. Tap “Place Order on WhatsApp” and send the prepared message.</p><h2>Can I order different soap bases together?</h2><p>Yes. Add multiple variants and quantities to the same cart.</p><h2>Is delivery included in ₹110/kg?</h2><p>No. Shipping is quoted separately after you share your address and PIN code.</p><h2>How do I pay?</h2><p>Hisa Organic will share payment instructions after confirming your order and shipping charges on WhatsApp.</p><h2>Do you accept bulk enquiries?</h2><p>Yes. Send your required products and quantities through WhatsApp for a quotation.</p>`

function showInfoPage(key){if(!infoPages[key])return;document.getElementById('infoContent').innerHTML=infoPages[key];document.getElementById('infoPage').style.display='block';for(const id of ['products','productDetail']){const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.style.display='none'}for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('main > section, body > section')){if(el.id!=='infoPage'&&el.id!=='products'&&el.id!=='productDetail'&&el.id!=='overlay'){} }document.getElementById('infoPage').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})}
function closeInfoPage(){document.getElementById('infoPage').style.display='none';if(typeof showHome==='function')showHome();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})}

function showTrackingPage(){document.getElementById('infoPage').style.display='none';for(const id of ['products','productDetail']){const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.style.display='none'}document.getElementById('trackingPage').style.display='block';document.getElementById('trackingPage').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});const id=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('order');if(id){document.getElementById('trackOrderId').value=id;lookupTracking()}}
function closeTrackingPage(){document.getElementById('trackingPage').style.display='none';showHome()}
function getTrackingRecords(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hisa_tracking_demo')||'{}')}catch(e){return {}}}
function lookupTracking(){const id=document.getElementById('trackOrderId').value.trim().toUpperCase();const root=document.getElementById('trackResult');root.replaceChildren();if(!id){root.textContent='Please enter an Order ID.';return}const r=getTrackingRecords()[id];if(!r){root.textContent='No dispatch record found in this browser demo. Please contact Hisa Organic on WhatsApp for tracking details.';return}const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent='Order: '+id+' | Status: '+r.status+' | Courier: '+r.courier+' | AWB: '+r.awb;root.append(p);if(r.link&&/^https:\/\//i.test(r.link)){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=r.link;a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener noreferrer';a.textContent='Open Courier Tracking ↗';root.append(a)}if(r.photo){const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=r.photo;img.alt='Courier tracking slip';root.append(document.createElement('br'),img)}}
function saveTrackingDemo(e){e.preventDefault();const id=document.getElementById('adminOrder').value.trim().toUpperCase();const link=document.getElementById('adminLink').value.trim();if(!/^https:\/\//i.test(link)){alert('Enter a valid HTTPS courier tracking link.');return}const record={courier:document.getElementById('adminCourier').value.trim(),awb:document.getElementById('adminAwb').value.trim(),status:document.getElementById('adminStatus').value,link};const file=document.getElementById('adminPhoto').files[0];const save=()=>{try{const records=getTrackingRecords();records[id]=record;localStorage.setItem('hisa_tracking_demo',JSON.stringify(records));document.getElementById('adminTrackingMsg').textContent='Saved in this browser only. Send the courier tracking link separately on WhatsApp until the website has a live database.';document.getElementById('trackOrderId').value=id;lookupTracking()}catch(err){alert('Could not save; try a smaller photo.')}};if(file){if(file.size>700000){alert('Use a photo under 700 KB for this browser demo.');return}const reader=new FileReader();reader.onload=()=>{record.photo=reader.result;save()};reader.readAsDataURL(file)}else save()}

function fragranceBottleSvg(i){const color=fragranceColors[i%fragranceColors.length];const svg=`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="240" height="320" viewBox="0 0 240 320"><defs><linearGradient id="b" x1="0" x2="1"><stop stop-color="#e9e9e9"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#ffffff"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#dedede"/></linearGradient></defs><ellipse cx="120" cy="299" rx="75" ry="9" fill="#d9ddd8" opacity=".5"/><rect x="91" y="15" width="58" height="47" rx="7" fill="url(#b)" stroke="#d5d5d5"/><path d="M88 54h64v19q0 8 13 17l11 12q7 7 7 20v148q0 22-22 22H79q-22 0-22-22V122q0-13 7-20l11-12q13-9 13-17Z" fill="#fafafa" stroke="#c9d1ca" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M62 164h116v107q0 17-17 17H79q-17 0-17-17Z" fill="${color}" opacity=".63"/><rect x="69" y="129" width="102" height="88" rx="5" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e0e7de"/><text x="120" y="159" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-weight="bold" fill="#124a32">HISA</text><text x="120" y="176" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" fill="#124a32">ORGANIC</text><text x="120" y="197" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" fill="#425c4a">FRAGRANCE</text></svg>`;return 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,'+encodeURIComponent(svg)}
